from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

# Re-login
acc=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
venmo_pw=[a['password'] for a in acc if a['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

roommates=[
 {'email':'an-harrison@gmail.com','name':'Anthony Harrison'},
 {'email':'anita.burch@gmail.com','name':'Anita Burch'},
 {'email':'mel.bailey@gmail.com','name':'Melissa Bailey'}
]

now=datetime.now()
min_created_at=f'{now.year}-03-01'
max_created_at=now.date().isoformat()

def fetch_all_transactions(user_email,direction):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token,user_email=user_email,min_created_at=min_created_at,max_created_at=max_created_at,direction=direction,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        print('user',user_email.split('@')[0],'dir',direction,'page',page_index,'count',len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        out.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
    return out

sent_total=Decimal('0')
received_total=Decimal('0')

for rm in roommates:
    tx_sent=fetch_all_transactions(rm['email'],'sent')
    tx_received=fetch_all_transactions(rm['email'],'received')
    # sum amounts
    s=sum(Decimal(str(tx['amount'])) for tx in tx_sent)
    r=sum(Decimal(str(tx['amount'])) for tx in tx_received)
    print('roommate',rm['name'],'sent_sum',s,'received_sum',r,'n_sent',len(tx_sent),'n_received',len(tx_received))
    sent_total += s
    received_total += r

print('sent_total',sent_total)
print('received_total',received_total)
print('grand_total',sent_total+received_total)
